toast.mini_fertig: Found them all! Gooby is bursting with pride.
toast.souvenir_leer: The souvenir spot is empty — something new will be here tomorrow!
toast.keine_kamera: No camera, no vacation photo! Bäm at the POW! surely has one for you.

strand: YOU'RE HERE! I already told the ocean about you. It's roaring with joy!
I touched a wave! It was wet. Research complete.
My sandcastle has four towers. One is reserved for you!
A seagull wanted my cookie. We negotiated. She won.
Sand between your toes is SCIENTIFICALLY proven to tickle best.
I named the parasol: Shady. Shady is loyal.
The salt water tastes like fries without the fries. Fascinating!
In the evening the sea turns orange. I saved the prettiest wave for you.
berge: YOU'RE HERE! The mountains have an echo — it knows your name now!
I stared at a mountain flower until it got shy. I think.
The tent and I are friends now. It snores a little at night.
Campfire rule number one: marshmallow thoughts are allowed.
The air up here tastes like freshly washed clouds!
I hopped up a whole hill. Without a break! Almost without a break.
A marmot whistled. I whistled back. We are in talks.
There are SO many stars at night. I stopped counting at three million.
stadt: YOU'RE HERE! The city is huge — but way cozier with you around.
The waiter already knows me. I'm officially a regular. Since yesterday.
My ice cream had three scoops. Now it has zero scoops. Time is strange.
I waved at the big tower. I'm sure it sparkled back.
The alleys smell like fresh waffles. I keep a scent map in my head.
The string lights come on at night and the whole square turns golden. Like it's for us!
I looked into a shop window and a very handsome Gooby looked back.
Street music! I danced along until the hat was full of applause.
weltraum: YOU'RE HERE! Everything is so light up here — even my ears float!
I waved at the Earth. It kept turning. I think that means yes.
Moon dust is like icing sugar, just without the taste. Sadly. I checked.
My helmet fogs up when I'm happy. It is VERY foggy right now.
A shooting-star wish for you is already on its way. Please leave the mailbox open!
I named a crater after you. It's round and cosy. Like you!

bestellung: The usual for Mister Gooby: one plate of sunshine, extra warm!
Today I recommend: cloud soup with glitter croutons. Very fluffy!
One "Holiday Greetings" sundae — three scoops of wanderlust with sprinkles!
For the fine guest: shell pasta WITHOUT shells, but WITH extra hihi.
Our special: yesterday's plate of crumbs. The chef insists!

soul.1: Remember when you visited me on vacation? BEST day!
soul.2: Vacation is great. Vacation with a visitor is greater. That's math.
soul.3: I memorized a souvenir spot for us. For next time!
soul.4: My heart still makes little waves when I think of the sea.
soul.5: Experiencing things together is my favorite hobby. Right after snacks.
soul.6: Next vacation I'LL show YOU the best spots. I mapped everything!

los.strand: Find the seashells in the sand — tap them!
los.berge: Five mountain flowers bloom somewhere — can you find them?
los.weltraum: Five star splinters twinkle in the moon dust — collect them!

urlaub.streicheln: Gooby dances with holiday joy! (+{n} fun)
